Reporting to the Head of [Location masked] CHC Business Analysis & Controlling, the Finance Manager will work with the team on regional consolidation of the [Location masked] CHC budget, forecast, and actuals, coordinate with the eCommerce Sales team on monthly sales reporting, support Headcount reporting together with People & Culture, assist with processing of quarterly Royalty payments for JV partners, and contribute to Monthly IBP valorization, budget presentations, financial presentations, and other projects requested by management.

Global Business Analytics & Controlling
GBU Finance team: Controlling + Global + Industrial Affairs/Research & Development + Internal control
Finance teams: [Location masked] Finance Business Partners from other business units + corporate teams + Global Support Functions + Global Business Services
People & Culture
ECommerce Sales Team
Internal & external auditors
The department handles overall monthly book closing, three forecast cycles per year, the annual business plan, and overall reporting of [Location masked] for CHC.
cond_0126.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Finance is required
MBA and/or CPA is preferred
8+ Years of work experience, preferably in a Corporate Finance or Accounting environment
High level of financial information systems knowledge: preferably SAP, TM1, and HFM

Reporting to the Head of [Location masked] CHC Business Analysis & Controlling, the Finance Manager will be regularly working with a wide range of internal teams and will be responsible for:
Regional consolidation of the [Location masked] CHC budget, forecast, and actuals
Partnering with the eCommerce Sales team to complete monthly sales reporting
Headcount reporting in conjunction with People & Culture
Processing of quarterly Royalty payments for JV partners
Monthly IBP valorization
Other activities and deliverables such as preparing budget presentations, financial presentations, and other projects requested by management.
The primary function of this role is to assist and support operational activities such as monthly accounting close and forecast cycle. A large part of the day-to-day involves staying in contact with finance and business teams across the organisation.
cond_0447.responsibilities:
Prepare Monthly, Quarterly, and Annual Financial reports and associated analyses including Net Sales Commentary, Monthly performance review, and budget/forecast presentations for review by the Head of [Location masked] CHC Business Analysis & Controlling
Consolidate customer sales data for the eCommerce team and report to Global BA&C through [Product name masked]
Work closely with People & Culture on a monthly basis to make any necessary corrections and ensure accurate headcount tracking
Manage Audit requests through [Product name masked], handling questions and walking stakeholders through documentation as needed
Analyse and track quarterly royalty payments to Alza
Prepare and submit supporting documentation to invoice JV Partnership for work on multi-year projects
Monthly IBP Valorization — connect with the [Product name masked] CoE to provide updates on missing and incorrect GMID product details to support accurate demand forecast
Other tasks and duties as delegated by the Head of [Location masked] CHC Financial Performance
Key interactions include:
Global Business Analytics & Controlling
GBU Finance team: Controlling, Global, Industrial Affairs/Research & Development, Internal Control
Finance teams: [Location masked] Finance Business Partners from other business units, corporate teams, Global Support Functions, Global Business Services
People & Culture
ECommerce Sales Team
Internal & external auditors
The department handles overall monthly book closing, three forecast cycles per year, the annual business plan, and overall reporting of [Location masked] for CHC.
cond_0447.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Finance is required
MBA and/or CPA is preferred
8+ Years of work experience, preferably in a Corporate Finance or Accounting environment
High level of financial information systems knowledge: preferably SAP, TM1, and HFM
Strong analytical and communication skills — including presentation, listening, and written communication — to clearly explain trade-offs and walk stakeholders through financial results
Knowledge of generally accepted accounting principles: IFRS and US GAAP
Advanced Excel skills including pivot tables, V-lookups, and macros; SAP and TM1 preferred
Ability to manage and prioritise multiple deadlines with proven follow-through, including when priorities shift
Intermediate capability across systems and tools: TM1/SAP/BW, dashboards, Excel/PowerPoint
IBP experience (Integrated Business Process, typically consumer goods background)

Reporting to the Head of [Location masked] CHC Business Analysis & Controlling, the Finance Manager will be responsible for regional consolidation of the [Location masked] CHC budget, forecast, and actuals, coordinating with the eCommerce Sales team on monthly sales reporting, headcount reporting with People & Culture, processing of quarterly Royalty payments for JV partners, monthly IBP valorization, and other deliverables such as budget presentations, financial presentations, and projects requested by management.
The primary function of this role is to support operational activities such as monthly accounting close and forecast cycle.
cond_0646.responsibilities:
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports and associated analyses including Net Sales Commentary, monthly performance review, and budget/forecast presentations for the Head of [Location masked] CHC Business Analysis & Controlling
Consolidate customer sales data for the eCommerce team and report to Global BA&C through [Product name masked]
Coordinate with People & Culture on a monthly basis to ensure accurate headcount tracking and make any necessary corrections
Handle Audit requests through [Product name masked]
Analyse and track quarterly royalty payments to Alza
Prepare and submit supporting documentation to invoice JV Partnership for work on multi-year projects
Complete monthly IBP Valorization; provide updates to [Product name masked] CoE for missing and incorrect GMID product details to support accurate demand forecast
Other tasks and duties as delegated by the Head of [Location masked] CHC Financial Performance
Key coordination points for this role include:
Global Business Analytics & Controlling
GBU Finance team: Controlling, Global, Industrial Affairs/Research & Development, Internal Control
Finance teams: [Location masked] Finance Business Partners from other business units, corporate teams, Global Support Functions, Global Business Services
People & Culture
ECommerce Sales Team
Internal & external auditors
The department handles overall monthly book closing, three forecast cycles per year, the annual business plan, and overall reporting of [Location masked] for CHC.
cond_0646.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Finance required
MBA and/or CPA preferred
8+ Years of work experience, preferably in a Corporate Finance or Accounting environment
Strong knowledge of financial information systems; SAP, TM1, and HFM preferred
Ability to manage multiple deadlines and shifting priorities with consistent follow-through
Strong analytical skills and clear written and verbal communication
Knowledge of generally accepted accounting principles: IFRS and US GAAP
Advanced Excel skills including pivot tables, V-lookups, and macros; SAP and TM1 preferred
Ability to organise, manage, and prioritise deadlines
Intermediate proficiency in relevant systems and tools (TM1/SAP/BW, dashboard, Excel/PowerPoint)
IBP experience (Integrated Business Process, typically consumer goods background)
